bio: What started as a shop selling eggs and butter later became a delicatessen and today this spot is a popular bistro with a pleasingly lively urban atmosphere and an open kitchen. The tasty dishes include German classics such as currywurst and Wiener schnitzel, but also international dishes. The food is accompanied by decent wines by the glass, and the service is friendly. Open from noon to 8pm, last orders 6.30pm. NB: They don't take reservations at lunchtime – so come early, as the place gets very busy....
